messages.author: 8e9832545724d899
messages.subject: Updated MacOS/R/INLA/inlabru is not working
parts:
Hello all,

I have recently updated my MacOS and subsequently updated R, INLA and INLABRU to their latest testing/developmental versions as follows:
R version 4.3.0 (2023-04-21), inlabru_2.7.0.9012 and INLA_23.06.12

Unfortunately my model code is no longer working since I have updated, leading to crashes. Even the LGCP - Distance sampling vignette is no longer working for me. Either it crashes or the resulting estimates are wildly incorrect if it is able to converge.

Is this issue reproducible for others with the vignette? Or is it perhaps a problem with my package installations on my end.

Cheers,
Andrew

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Updated MacOS/R/INLA/inlabru is not working
parts:
The inlabru website was rebuilt 2 days ago and it had no problem with the inla version it had then; I’ll ask it to rerun with the new version (but it runs on Ubuntu to do that, so won’t notice mac specific issues; I’ll rerun the automated inlabru tests as well, that do test on one Mac version at least.)

Finn

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Updated MacOS/R/INLA/inlabru is not working
parts:
There were some minor issues in the inlabru code but nothing that
should cause issues with the bru/lgcp calls themselves.

There is however a new issue resulting in some of the distancesampling
vignette code leading to this:

GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=95166
GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=95167
Segmentation fault (core dumped)

Error: C stack usage 43239435 is too close to the limit

This is likely a new inla issue, as the vignette code hasn't changed.

Finn
